text: Bol and Rial [flee South Sudan|trigger|running from trouble] across the English Channel in an overcrowded boat, and their daughter Nyagak is lost to the sea. Granted probational asylum, they are assigned [a shabby house with peeling walls|images|the house and its rooms] on the outskirts of London, where they are [met with racism by their neighbours|who_suffers|outcasts and the marginalised] and warned that any breach could mean deportation. As Bol tries to fit in and Rial clings to their culture, visions of Nyagak and a mysterious man slip into the walls, and Rial names the presence [an apeth, a night witch|threat|witchcraft and cursed things].
